citations.title: More of Your CompanyCam Data Is Now Open to the Tools You Already Use | CompanyCam News Center
excerpts: Shared by Austyn • September 08, 2026

**Documents Can Now Be Created and Edited Through the API, Not Just Read** Until now, the API and MCP integration could only pull existing Documents (formerly called Pages) out of CompanyCam. You could read them, but you couldn't build new ones or make changes through that connection. That's changed: you can now draft and edit Documents and reports directly through the API and MCP. If you run an integration or an AI tool that generates project reports, it can write a finished document straight into CompanyCam the moment a job wraps, using your latest photos, without anyone opening the app to build it by hand.
